trail.text: Latency is spiking across travel services — I'll trace the source to rank the likely culprits.
The median latency points to travel as central while route and train show only tail effects — I'll check their dependencies to separate cause from victim.
Downstream stores look healthy, pointing to travel itself — I'll compare onset timing to confirm the ordering.
Food service shows a similar median shift to travel — I'll investigate shared dependencies and additional candidates.
Timing shows route and train degraded first but can't explain the full median impact — I'll sweep remaining services for a common cause.
I've mapped the failure pattern across the core services — now I'll submit the final root-cause ranking.

causes.reasoning: Median latency 0.08s to 2.53s across all percentiles with CPU and memory-failures up while travel-mongo and callees medians stay healthy indicates self-originated slowdown that makes callers admin-travel and UI look bad.
Median 0.067s to 0.72s across all percentiles with CPU and memory-failures up while downstream food-map-service stays healthy indicates self-originated slowdown independent of travel.
Tail 0.023s to 0.56s earliest at 8s but median barely changed and CPU down suggests tail victim/propagator that helps explain travel caller latency rather than primary CPU pressure.
Tail 0.029s to 0.61s earliest at 8s but median unchanged and CPU/requests down suggests downstream victim that contributes to travel aggregation delay.
Tail 0.047s to 0.48s onset 13s with median unchanged and CPU down suggests victim of the same travel-related congestion rather than origin.
